description: Technical key/value sheet for machine state and snapshots. All columns are hidden and not user-editable. Secrets are forbidden; no api_key, token, password, or secret keys are allowed.

columns.name: Key
columns.description: System key name. Must be one of allowed_keys.

columns.name: Value
columns.description: System value. For JSON-bearing keys the value is a serialized JSON string.

columns.name: Value_type
columns.description: Declared type of the stored value.

allowed_keys.description: Stable machine identifier of the current/last calculation.
ISO 8601 UTC timestamp of the last system update.
Vision model identifier used for the last input understanding run.
ISO 4217 currency code used for the last calculation.
FX rate used for currency conversion in the last calculation.
ISO 8601 UTC timestamp when the price snapshot was created.
Serialized JSON of the price snapshot used for the last calculation.
Application version that wrote the system state.
Construction profile version used for the last calculation.
Serialized JSON of the confirmed configuration used for the last calculation.
Serialized JSON of the construction result for the last calculation.
